content: AF5 DCB API (docs.axoniq.io 5.4): events carry zero-to-N @EventTag values; @EventSourcedEntity(tagKey=...) resolves the sourcing criteria from a single id, or a static @EventCriteriaBuilder method returns an EventCriteria for composite ids (university demo uses SubscriptionId(courseId,studentId) via @TargetEntityId). EventCriteria.havingTags(...) is AND across tags; andBeingOneOfTypes(...) is OR across types; EventCriteria.either(a,b) is OR across criteria. When appending, the framework builds the AppendCondition by combining the sourcing condition with the tags of the newly appended events, and attaches the consistency marker returned as the terminal event of sourcing. Command sequencing is ON by default (RoutingKeySequencingPolicy) and serializes commands sharing a routing key.
